formal_statement: ∀ p : Polynomial ℕ, ∃ l : ℕ, ∀ ρ : List (Set (Fin (2 ^ l + 1) × Fin l → Bool)), PEqualNP.Search.IsTriDagFor (fun v : Fin (2 ^ l + 1) × Fin l => decide (2 * v.2.val < l)) (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.BPHP (2 ^ l + 1) l) ρ → p.eval (2 ^ l) < ρ.length
plain_statement: Under the split giving the first half of the bit columns to one player, every triangle dag solving the search problem of bit PHP with 2^l+1 pigeons and 2^l holes has superpolynomially many nodes in 2^l. Known result formalized: Beame and Whitmeyer, ICALP 2025 (LIPIcs 334:21), Theorem 1.7 of ECCC TR25-057, bound 2^(n^(1/4)/sqrt 2 - 2). Strengthens L-lib-090 (rectangles are triangles).
title: Beame-Whitmeyer: triangle dags for the bit pigeonhole search problem are superpolynomial
